# PocSomm

> PocSomm is an iOS app that puts a sommelier in your pocket. Scan a restaurant wine list to instantly see estimated retail prices, value assessments, and critic ratings for every wine; photograph a bottle label for tasting notes; match wines to your meal with AI-powered food pairing; or ask the built-in sommelier for suggestions. No account, no subscription — free to download with starter credits, then one-time credit packs.

PocSomm is made by Melkar, LLC, a husband-and-wife team. It is available on the
Apple App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6760143052 (an Android version is
in development).

## Key features

- Wine list scanning: photograph any restaurant wine list (or import a PDF/URL)
  and every wine is identified and enriched with an estimated retail price, a
  value label (Great value / Fair price / High markup), and critic ratings when
  available. By-the-glass and by-the-bottle entries are told apart.
- Bottle scanning: point the camera at a label for an instant plain-language
  profile — flavor, body, serving temperature, decanting and cellaring tips,
  plus full sommelier notes on demand.
- Food pairing: photograph the food menu, pick the table's dishes, then scan
  the wine list; every wine is ranked with a match percentage and the
  reasoning behind each pairing.
- Ask PocSomm: describe what you're eating and get wine suggestions, or browse
  the built-in grape encyclopedia (flavors, key regions, classic pairings).
- Personalization: 11 app languages (English, French, Italian, Spanish,
  German, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese, Swedish, Dutch, Korean), selectable
  currency & market so price estimates match where you are, adjustable value
  thresholds, and a choice of 1–5, 1–10, or 1–20 rating scales.
- History: every scan is saved on the device; wines can be rated and revisited.

## Pricing

- Free to download, with starter credits included.
- Each scan costs a credit or two depending on size; larger imports cost more.
- Top up with one-time credit packs (in-app purchase). No subscription, no
  account, and credits never expire.

## Privacy

- No account and no sign-up; scans, ratings, and history live only on the
  user's device.
- Photos are sent to Google's Gemini AI service only to extract wine details;
  they are never stored on PocSomm servers (there are none) and never sold.
- No ads, no cross-app tracking.
